Name: SteckNY Path Pack
Author: SteckNy
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SteckNY Path Pack[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Give your farm more ways to connect gardens, frame buildings, and create inviting walkways. SteckNY Path Pack adds seven separate craftable paths without replacing any vanilla paths or textures.
Included paths
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Classic Brick:[/b] traditional red brick with light mortar.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Brick & Grass:[/b] larger bricks with textured green joints and softened edges.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Original Brick & Grass:[/b] smaller bricks with narrow grass joints.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Pavers:[/b] small grey paving stones.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Grass-Jointed Pavers:[/b] grey paving stones separated by green grass.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sidewalk:[/b] textured grey concrete with vertical expansion joints.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Timber-Edged Grass:[/b] a grass center framed by thick brown timber edging. Borders follow connected shapes, leaving wider areas open inside.[/color][/*]
[/list]All seven recipes appear automatically in your crafting menu. No shop purchase or skill level is required, and the pack works with existing saves.
Craft a path, select it in your toolbar, and place it like an ordinary path. Remove it with a pickaxe to recover the item.
Each material connects to matching tiles. The timber edging is decorative and walkable—it does not act as a fence.
Crafting recipes
Every recipe produces [b]5 path tiles[/b].

[b][size=4]Compatibility and notes[/size][/b]

The pack uses its own items and textures, leaving vanilla paths available. It does not edit the textures used by vanilla path recolor mods.
Path artwork stays the same throughout the seasons.
For multiplayer, all players should install the same version. Multiplayer-specific testing has not been completed.
